blueprint.description: Classic two-player Pong with paddle physics, ball collision, and score tracking — A complete Pong implementation with paddle movement, ball bouncing physics, collision detection, score tracking, and AI opponent mode

research.context:
📋 Reference designs found from the web, GitHub, and open source alternatives:
  • Top 6 pong-game Open-Source Projects - LibHunt
    Which are the best open-source pong-game projects? This list will help you: TouchBarPong, clash-pong, Pong-curses, pong-is-not-ping, multi-window-pong-game, and Qlearning-Pong-Workshop-in-Cpp.
  • Top 19 pong Open-Source Projects | LibHunt
    Which are the best open-source pong projects? This list will help you: pong-command, TouchBarPong, cobol-js-emscripten, EnttPong, DQN-Atari, HCSR04-ultrasonic-sensor-lib, and unity-pong-tutorial.
  • ⭐217 jakesgordon/javascript-pong: A javascript version of the classic 1972 arcade game Pong!
  • ⭐122 UnityTechnologies/DOTS_Pong: This project is a simple creation of the classic Pong game with a DOTS implementation. The focus was on simplicity and using the latest entities synta
  • godot (gaming): Your open-source game engine
  • gdevelop (gaming): Free and easy game maker
